name: NgHivIntLabMonitoringRegister
title: NG HIV Integrated Laboratory Monitoring Register
description:
Logical model for the Nigeria HIV Integrated Laboratory Monitoring Register.
One instance represents one facility monthly register page and contains
repeatable patient-level laboratory entries corresponding to printed columns
A1 through A72.

mapping.name: NG HIV Integrated Laboratory Monitoring Register Column Mapping
mapping.comment: Maps logical-model elements to printed columns A1–A72.

element.short: NG HIV Integrated Laboratory Monitoring Register
element.definition:
Logical model for the Nigeria HIV Integrated Laboratory Monitoring Register.
One instance represents one facility monthly register page and contains
repeatable patient-level laboratory entries corresponding to printed columns
A1 through A72.
Identifier assigned to the monthly Integrated Laboratory Monitoring Register page or its electronic equivalent.
Reference to the facility maintaining the register, when available.
Official name of the facility maintaining the register.
State where the facility is located.
Local Government Area where the facility is located.
Monthly reporting period represented by the register page.
One patient-level row in the monthly Integrated Laboratory Monitoring Register.

Result value or narrative for the other laboratory test.
Testing platform used: GeneXpert, m-PIMA or conventional PCR laboratory.

Date the specimen was collected.
True when the specimen was logged remotely at the requesting facility; false when it was not.

Date the specimen was assayed.
Date the result was released by the testing laboratory.

mapping.map: A45 baseline 6 months / A46 annual routine / A47 clinical or immune failure / A48 32–36 weeks gestation / A49 post-EAC / A50 HIV Early Detect / A51 recent infection

element.short: A52–A67 Viral-load sex and age band
element.definition: One sex-and-age reporting band marked for a client with a viral-load result.
True when the viral-load result belongs to a pregnant client and is counted in the female total.
True when the viral-load result belongs to a breastfeeding client and is counted in the female total.

element.short: A70 HIV Early Detect viral-load result
element.definition: Viral-load result used to confirm suspected acute or recent HIV infection.
Machine or human error code recorded for failed point-of-care testing. The source workbook does not provide an error-code catalogue.
Additional notes, including specimen issues, invalid results or a need for repeat testing.
